ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Delivery, Onboarding and later stages need Account lead and Delivery lead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Onboarding", 1, "Kickoff done", 2, "First deliverables", 3, "Steady state", 4, "At risk", 5, "Wrapping up", 6, "Completed", 7, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(Account_lead__c), ISBLANK(Delivery_lead__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Account lead and Delivery lead before moving to Onboarding.
